title: War Remnants Museum
description: A famous museum in Ho Chi Minh City displaying artifacts and images about the Vietnam War.

title: Ho Chi Minh City Museum
description: A museum introducing the history of formation and development of Saigon – Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Nha Rong Wharf (Ho Chi Minh Museum)
description: Nha Rong Wharf is frequently visited by tourists and locals. It preserves many historical relics and displays images about the life and activities of President Ho Chi Minh.

title: Rung Sac Base
description: A revolutionary base relic in the Can Gio mangrove forest during the resistance war.

title: Ben Thanh Market
description: Saigon's famous symbol, a bustling trading place that attracts tourists.

title: Binh Tay Market
description: A large market in District 6 featuring ancient East Asian architecture, a commercial center for the Chinese community.

title: Giac Lam Pagoda
description: The oldest pagoda in Saigon, built in 1744 with traditional architecture.

title: Giac Vien Pagoda
description: A pagoda famous for its ancient wooden architecture and precious Buddha statues.

title: Secret Weapon Depot
description: A revolutionary relic, a secret place to hide weapons for combat in Saigon.

title: Cu Chi Tunnels
description: A famous underground tunnel network demonstrating the resilient spirit of the Vietnamese army and people.

title: Phu Tho Hoa Tunnels
description: A historical revolutionary relic with a tunnel system dug during the resistance against the French.

title: Thong Tay Hoi Communal House (Dinh)
description: The oldest communal house in Ho Chi Minh City, featuring unique traditional Southern architecture.

title: Binh Dong Communal House (Dinh)
description: A long-standing communal house in District 8, associated with the history of the Chinese community.

title: Chi Hoa Communal House (Dinh)
description: An ancient communal house carrying cultural and folk belief value in Saigon.

title: Independence Palace (Reunification Palace)
description: A historical and architectural landmark, associated with the event of April 30, 1975.

title: Phong Phu Communal House (Dinh)
description: An ancient communal house associated with the cultural and belief traditions of the local people.

title: Cho Quan Hospital Detention Area
description: A revolutionary relic that was once a place to detain and torture patriotic soldiers.

title: Tomb of Le Van Duyet (Lang Ong Ba Chieu)
description: The tomb area of the Viceroy of Gia Dinh Citadel, a prominent historical relic in Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Lion-Unicorn-Dragon Dance (Lan Su Rong)
description: Lion-Unicorn-Dragon dance is a distinctive cultural feature during festivals and the Lunar New Year (Tet).

title: Khai Ha Cau An Festival (Opening Ceremony for Peace)
description: A traditional festival to pray for peace and favorable harvests for the people.

title: Nghinh Ong Festival (Whale God Worship)
description: A unique festival of Southern fishermen to honor the Whale God and pray for good catches.

title: Lantern Festival (Tet Nguyen Tieu)
description: A traditional festival of the Chinese community featuring lantern processions and lion dances.

title: Hung Loi Ancient Pottery Kiln
description: Hung Loi ancient pottery kiln — a national archaeological relic in District 8, HCMC, is an ancient mound containing the ruins of three interconnected pottery kilns with many fragments of jars, urns, and pots... reflecting the ancient pottery craft of Saigon.

title: Tomb of Phan Chau Trinh
description: The resting place of the patriotic scholar Phan Chau Trinh in Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Nga Ba Giong Historical Site
description: A historical relic, marking the sacrifice of many revolutionary soldiers.

title: Ho Chi Minh City Opera House
description: An ancient French architectural work, the city's major center for performing arts.

title: Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral
description: An ancient French architectural symbol in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Ngoc Phuong Temple (Tịnh Xá Ngọc Phương)
description: A famous Buddhist temple (tịnh xá) known for its serene architecture and characteristic Southern Theravada Buddhist style.

title: Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee Headquarters
description: A prominent French architectural work, currently the working office of the city government.

title: Vovinam
description: Vietnam's traditional martial art famous for its martial spirit and diverse techniques.
